command.description.en: Select the model for this conversation
command.description.zh: 选择本会话使用的模型

option.deepseekV4Flash.description.en: Fast, efficient, and economical; suited to focused, routine, or parallel tasks.
option.deepseekV4Flash.description.zh: 快速、高效且经济；适合目标明确、常规或并行任务。

option.deepseekV4Pro.description.en: Stronger agentic coding, knowledge, and difficult reasoning; suited to complex or quality-critical tasks at higher cost.
option.deepseekV4Pro.description.zh: 更强的自主编码、知识与复杂推理能力；适合复杂或质量优先的任务，但成本更高。

trigger.ariaEffort.zh: 选择模型，当前 {model}，推理等级 {effort}

error.sessionInUse.en: This session is already in use, possibly by another running DSH instance (such as dsh web or the desktop app). Quit other running DSH instances and try again.
error.sessionInUse.zh: 当前会话已被占用，可能是其他正在运行的 DSH 导致的（如其他 dsh web、桌面端），请退出其他正在运行的 DSH 后重试。

empty.efforts.en: This model provides no reasoning effort levels.
empty.efforts.zh: 当前模型未提供推理等级。
